summary: The team reviewed the payments project backend migration, noting API latency at 450 ms versus a target under 200 ms due to PostgreSQL queries. A decision was made to add a Redis cache and remain with PostgreSQL, while a Kubernetes migration was only suggested. The budget of $5,000 for cloud costs was approved, and several action items were assigned. The next meeting will be at the same time next week.

points: API latency currently about 450 milliseconds, target under 200 milliseconds
Main cause identified as PostgreSQL queries on the orders table
Suggestion to move the whole system to Kubernetes was mentioned but not agreed
Decision to add Redis cache in front of the orders service
Decision to stay with PostgreSQL and not use MongoDB
Approved five thousand dollars for cloud cost this month
Builds are failing on GitHub Actions; someone needs to look at the CI/CD pipeline, not yet assigned
